verdict.rationale: Government online services can publish machine-readable API specs, so this axis applies. The pack shows no downloadable spec: every OpenAPI and Swagger path probed returned 404. MeF's XML format and IRIS's credential-gated A2A channel are machine channels, but nothing documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent schema for either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
